_comment: Bot personalities, keyed by the class 'ai' field. Ranges in metres. melee: never | close | prefer. usesVehicles: never | opportunistic | always. abilityEagerness scales every ability score. retreatHp = HP fraction below which the bot breaks off to heal or escape.

difficulty._comment: reactionTime: seconds before reacting to a new target/cast. aimSpeed: rad/s turn rate. aimError: degrees of wandering error. recoilComp: 0-1 share of recoil pulled down. interruptChance: odds of using a stun/silence on an enemy cast when able. command: the side's commander when the AI has the seat (src/ai/FrontlineCommander.js, src/ai/command/Strategist.js): obey, odds a squad goes at once when it can; interval, s between plans; hold, s a squad keeps a standing task before it's re-shared (default 20); mind, the Strategist carries the plan out (home sector guarded, attacks staged, scouts, the guns preparing attacks; else plain standing orders); stage, attacks wait to go in together; scout, scouts out at once; fire, it calls fire missions; search, plans weighed per think beyond the book (0: the book; with search, also responses, noise, margin, reserve).
